integrity: Analytic semigroup proof; finite exact-rational consistency checks supplementary only. No independent external validation or originality certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-horizon infected-mass comparison in the susceptible-frozen linearized mutation–selection model; no claim about the fully nonlinear epidemic peak, final size, or cost-optimal clinical policy.
Translation of a single fixed nonnegative contact-window profile on a reversible nearest-neighbor trait chain or reflecting bounded continuum; monotone initial trait densities.
No optimality statement for nonmonotone initial densities, nonreversible mutation, or heterogeneous recovery.
title: Initial infectivity order reverses optimal contact-window timing under reversible mutation
